categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in precision cutting tools, including precision complex cutting tools and precision high-efficiency cutting tools, along with high-end production services such as precision grinding, process services, inspection, and custom design. Its products serve high-end equipment manufacturing sectors like aerospace, automotive, intelligent drives, robotics, power stations, wind power, engineering machinery, and rail transit.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including proprietary high-performance high-speed steel and carbide materials, precision heat treatment, surface strengthening technologies like composite and ion treatments, and precision measurement techniques. It employs flexible intelligent manufacturing lines with a 'product + service + intelligent manufacturing' integrated business model, emphasizing R&D in gear, spline, and thread processing technologies and customized tool design.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large-scale precision parts and equipment manufacturers in industries such as aerospace, automotive core components, intelligent drives, wind power equipment, engineering machinery, power stations, shipbuilding, steel structure engineering, and rail transit. The company also serves international markets through subsidiaries in the US and Austria.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with 94.69% of revenue generated domestically, and has expanded its international presence via wholly-owned subsidiaries in the United States and Austria to serve European and American markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and servicing of precision cutting tools and measurement instruments used by downstream high-end equipment manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include internationalization, intelligent manufacturing, lean production, and scaling operations. R&D focuses on developing high-precision, high-efficiency, and specialized cutting tools, enhancing tool life and cutting efficiency, and integrating intelligent manufacturing technologies. The company actively collaborates with universities and research institutes and invests in new product development, process improvements, and synchronized product development with customers.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of precision cutting tools and provision of high-end production services such as precision grinding and process consulting. Sales are conducted via direct sales to end users and through distributors, with a focus on customized solutions and technical services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading innovator and market leader in China's precision cutting tool industry, recognized as a national technology innovation demonstration enterprise and a 'single champion' in specialized fields. It competes with domestic and international tool manufacturers, with a competitive edge in rapid local response, comprehensive product range, and integrated technical support and services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 608 million, an 8.39% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 129 million, slightly down due to convertible bond interest expenses. Total assets grew by 40.67% to RMB 2.24 billion. The company maintains a steady growth trajectory with expanding R&D investment and international market development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high precision, high efficiency, high stability, and specialization in its products, offering integrated cutting and measurement solutions tailored to customer needs. Its value proposition includes advanced material selection, proprietary surface treatment technologies, comprehensive customization capabilities, and localized rapid technical support, positioning it as a preferred domestic alternative to imported precision cutting tools.
